rule dac_gh_0039 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Org IP allow list disabled or emptied - org.update_ip_allow_list disable"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0039"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1685"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.update_ip_allow_list_enabled" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.disable_ip_allow_list" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "business.update_ip_allow_list" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
